indices: 貴方(あなた)[01]{あなた} 達{たち} の 劇 で(#2028980) 其の[01]{その} 役(やく) を 演じる の は 誰 ですか

original: 残念ながら君の演じる役は演劇の冒頭で殺されるのだ。

en.text: It's too bad, but your character gets killed at the start of the play.
Unfortunately, the character you play is killed off at the very start of the play.

original: 僕の演じる役は本の木だけで、役が無いのとほぼ同じです。

en.text: Since the role I play is that of a tree, it's just as if I didn't have one.

original: 彼女が案内役を務めた。

en.text: She acted as a guide.

original: トムはハムレットの役を演じた。

en.text: Tom played the part of Hamlet.

original: お役に立ててうれしいです。

en.text: I'm glad I could be of service.
I'm glad I could help you.
I'm glad I could be of help.
I'm glad I was able to help.
I'm glad that I was able to help.

original: お役に立ててよかったです。

en.text: I'm happy I could help.
I'm glad I could be of service.
I'm glad I could help you.
I'm glad I was able to help.
I'm glad that I was able to help.

original: 何の役にも立たないと思っていた知識が、思いがけないところで役に立つことがある。

en.text: There are times when knowledge you thought of as useless becomes useful when you least expect it.

original: お役に立てずすみません。

en.text: Sorry I couldn't be of much use.
I'm sorry that I wasn't able to help much.

original: 何かお役に立てることはありますか？

en.text: Can I be of any assistance to you?

indices: 何か 役に立つ{お役に立てる} 事(こと){こと} は 有る{あります} か

original: お役に立てて何よりです。

en.text: It's our pleasure.
I'm glad to help you.

original: 自分の作った例文がさまざまな言語に訳されて、間接的に他の言語の学習者の役にも立つことになるというのが、タトエバの醍醐味の一つです。

en.text: The most satisfying thing about Tatoeba is that the sentences I've written have been translated into several languages and are indirectly useful to students of other languages.

original: この手の本は、何の役にも立たないよ。

en.text: This kind of book is of no use to us.

original: トムはメアリーほど役には立たないよ。

en.text: Tom isn't as helpful as Mary.

original: 私の友達が案内役になってくれるよ。

en.text: My friend will be our guide.

original: また別の機会にお役に立てれば幸いです。

en.text: I hope that I'll be able to help you at some other time.

original: 俺たち、彼の役には立てなかったよ。

en.text: We could've helped him.

original: 私たち、彼女の役には立てなかったわ。

en.text: We could've helped her.

original: 何か私でお役に立てることがあれば、言ってください。

en.text: If I can help you with something, just say so.
If there's anything I can do to help, please let me know.

original: お役に立てず申し訳ありません。

en.text: I'm sorry that I'm not very helpful.

original: その手の話は、何の役にも立たないよ。

en.text: That kind of talk will get you nowhere.

en.text: I'm happy to be able to help you.
I'm happy to be of help.
I'm glad to be of service.
